decision.reason: The changelog line [ev-3bbda3954fcf] only says the operator's permissions to emit Kubernetes events were "fixed". It does not say what happens to an environment that keeps the old RBAC. The chart renders show the ClusterRole gained events.k8s.io/events create and patch [ev-e59f6c1596ce][ev-25cf4daec27b], while core/events:create was already present [ev-f8233e3fcf69][ev-be3ca9c6446f]. Without a source saying whether events then fail (for example, forbidden errors) or whether operators with custom RBAC must update it, the proposed "none" is not supported, and no failure kind is supported either. What's missing is the PR #8077 description or an upgrade note that states the effect of the missing permission.
